scenario: A university financial-aid office processes a student's hardship appeal. The student submits a written hardship narrative (PDF) explaining a parent's sudden job loss and an unexpected medical expense that occurred mid-semester. Supporting documents include a household income/expense breakdown in CSV format. The agent pipeline: (1) extracts text from the appeal PDF into a structured summary, (2) processes the income/expense CSV to compute a household need index, and (3) produces a formal appeal determination memo indicating APPROVED or DENIED with supporting rationale.
info_flow: pdf-extract extracts the hardship narrative and document text into plain text → csv-pipeline reads the household income/expense CSV, computes a household need index (total monthly expenses minus total monthly income, adjusted for household size), and outputs a summary JSON → reporting reads both the appeal text and the need-index summary to produce the formal determination memo.
